Post 1
📈 ASX 200 clears its 20-day MA, closing at 9,164.60 (+61.50pts, +0.68%). Defence and consumer names led the charge. Just 1.42% off the 52-week high. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
IT (+2.25%) and Consumer Staples (+2.11%) topped the sectors. 🔻 Energy (-0.78%) and A-REITs (-0.16%) the only drags. Breadth was solid — nine of eleven sectors finished green. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
🔺 EOS surged 23.02% to AUD 10.58. Defence spending tailwinds are real and the market is pricing them fast. ARB Corp added 13.87% — a big day for domestic industrials. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,502.62/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7140. Silver at AUD 96.12/oz. Metals firm, yet Materials only gained 0.30% — miners not keeping pace with the metal price. #gold #silver #ASX

Post 5
Watch the 9,200 level on the ASX 200 — that is the next clean resistance before the 52-week high. Are buyers willing to close that final 1.42% gap this week? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz
